free_text_notes.physician_note: 87-year-old woman with type 2 diabetes, atrial fibrillation, admitted 3/22 with HFpEF exacerbation precipitated by dietary sodium excess. Transitioned from IV to oral diuretic yesterday; weight stable. A venous thromboembolism risk assessment was completed on admission as per standard protocol. The patient received appropriate preventive measures during the stay. These are no longer needed after discharge.
free_text_notes.nursing_note: Vitals stable this shift. Tolerating diet. 3/26 07:45: A local independent pharmacy called: sacubitril/valsartan is out of stock until next week. No alternate pharmacy arranged. Pulse oximetry briefly read 94 percent during a deep sleep period overnight. Daytime readings have consistently been above 96 percent and no clinical concern was raised.
free_text_notes.case_manager_note: Plan is discharge home with nephew. A local independent pharmacy closes at 6. Please send the sacubitril/valsartan prescription straight to the pharmacy from the system.
